name: FAQ, one-liners
description: Short questions with one-line answers that are always visible, set as a list with dotted leaders between question and answer.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Six things people ask at the counter of Little Oven, each answered in a line.

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer in one line
itemFields.default: Cards and phones, and cash if you must.

default.question: When are you open?
default.answer: Tuesday to Saturday, 7.30 am until we sell out.

default.question: Is the sourdough vegan?
default.answer: Yes: flour, water, salt and a 12-year-old starter.

default.question: Do you bake gluten free?
default.answer: On Thursdays only, in a separate kitchen.

default.question: Can I order a celebration cake?
Can I reserve a loaf?
default.answer: Order online by 6 pm and collect the next morning.

default.question: Do you deliver?
default.answer: By bike within two miles of the shop, for £3.
